sentences.text: Petitioner is seeking to quash the complaint and FIR filed by respondent No.1/Police as per Annexures-1 and 2, in Cr.No.136/2024 of Govindaraja Nagar Police Station, Bengaluru City.

entities.text: Govindaraja Nagar Police Station, Bengaluru City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. On a complaint lodged by one Maruthi More/respondent No.4, aforementioned crime is registered against the petitioner for the offence punishable under Section 384, 417, 419, 420 and 506 of IPC.

3. In brief, it is alleged that the petitioner posing himself as a Police official induced the complainant that he has got contacts with the politicians and Police Officials and promising that he will provide a job to his wife and her nephew and for conducting survey of his land, in all received a sum of Rs.17 lakhs and cheated him and threatened with dire consequences etc.

4. A perusal of the complaint averments do disclose that there is a prima facie case against the NC:
2025:KHC:39649 HC-KAR petitioner.
At this stage, it cannot be said that the averments in the complaint are false.
The statutory power of the police to conduct investigation into allegations and to file an appropriate report cannot be curtailed.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner's account maintained in SBI and HDFC banks are freezed and therefore, necessary direction may be issued to defreeze the account.
6.
There is no material placed before the Court to show that the petitioner's accounts are freezed.
Nevertheless, the petitioner is at liberty to file appropriate petition/application before the jurisdictional Court for necessary orders in this regard.
With the above observations, petition is dismissed.
